title: rhynchoglossum notonianum
intro: Rhynchoglossum notonianum, commonly known as the Himalayan Hoya, is a species of flowering plant in the Apocynaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating pain and infections. The bioactive constituents of Rhynchoglossum notonianum include alkaloids and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
